text: Null shall have all pointer fields zero. Address-only data/ROM values shall have identity/offset/rights zero and nonzero cached coordinate. Equality shall distinguish null then compare cached coordinates, including expired values. Access/arithmetic shall require live matching registry identity, consistent coordinate/offset, rights, valid view, and readiness.
